hook: Coaches stop the run, not the blowout
description: Great coaches call timeouts on an 8-0 run, not a 20-point deficit. Here's how leaders can build the same early pattern interrupt into their teams.

title: Run Team Retrospectives Like Scrims, Not Status Meetings

description: Why deliberately limiting options, with fewer priorities, fixed timeboxes and narrower scope, leads to clearer choices and faster execution than open-ended flexibility.

title: Tilt Management: The 24-Hour Rule for Leaders
hook: Never decide five minutes after a loss
captions: Willpower fails when you need it
description: Tilt is the drop in decision quality after a setback. Borrow the gamer's fix: set a rule in advance to wait 24 hours before major decisions.
